verdict.rationale: Helicone publishes a REST API reference, for example the 'Get Requests' endpoint page with a copyable curl example against api.helicone.ai/v1/request/query. A probe also confirmed a served OpenAPI spec at docs.helicone.ai/swagger.json, so a structured, spec-backed API reference exists. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive, such as an in-browser 'try it' console that executes requests. The prompt Playground is a separate product feature, not an API reference. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive in-docs request runner, runnable (not just copyable) examples across endpoints, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
